paragraphs.text: Nohr was a weatherworker on Cridhe responsible for the Parting .

Nohr was weasel-faced and had dark hair. Gifted with weathersense, he was able to sense the change in weather patterns and accurately able to predict rain, snow, wind, and seasonal changes. He dreamed of travelling among the stars. He wore a blue robe. His family crest was an eagle, and he owned a pet eagle, Atalanta .

Haen and Nohr were childhood friends. After Haen was chosen as the Keeper of the Tree, Nohr grew envious of his friend. On midsummer eve around 3043 AR , after Nohr had been served a heavy drink and given a magical sword Soulslayer by the stranger Malvos , Nohr swore to break the Clan Tree of Cridhe to gain planeswalkerhood , an idea which had been given to him by Malvos. Despite Keeper Haen 's heavy protesting, Nohr split the tree, causing the Parting , a cataclysmic event that marked the downfall of Cridhe ’s natural order and the fragmentation of its people. Instead of opening a path to another plane, Nohr’s magic disrupted the Clan Tree’s life force, killing it and shattering its stability. This act fulfilled an ancient curse laid by Cridhe’s creator-god, the Maker : the land split in two, physically and spiritually dividing the people of the plane.

Nohr was wounded in this act by the tip of his own sword, which lodged in his chest to match the wound he had given Haen. His line would stay on one side of the chasm, with each generation's weatherworker born with a painful birthmark in the same location, destined to go mad around the age of thirty. Inys Nohr was named in honor of Nohr, despite his rash and harmful actions.
